Blockstream has identified Falcon-1024 as the most promising quantum-resistant signature scheme for Bitcoin, signaling a potential direction for future protocol upgrades.

Falcon-1024 is a lattice-based digital signature algorithm designed to withstand attacks from quantum computers, which pose a long-term threat to current elliptic curve cryptography used in Bitcoin. Blockstream's assessment points to it as the leading candidate should Bitcoin require a post-quantum cryptographic upgrade.

The finding carries significant implications for Bitcoin's long-term security architecture, as any transition to quantum-resistant signatures would require a network-wide consensus process and protocol changes.

🇺🇸 Major Apple outage hits multiple services at once

iCloud, Apple Pay, the App Store, Apple Music, Apple Card, Apple Support, Sign in with Apple, Apple Business Manager and iPhone activation all saw sharp spikes in user complaints on Tuesday.

Reports started coming in around 17:30 CET and jumped into the thousands within an hour. Apple Pay alone hit about 2,000 reports in a matter of minutes.

Users describe being unexpectedly signed out of iCloud on iPhones and Macs, App Store downloads failing, and payment problems. Developers say they can't log in to App Store Connect, the platform used to manage their apps.

At first Apple's status page showed everything as available. Apple later admitted that iCloud sign-in "may be slow or unavailable," that AppleCare on device is down for all users, and that the App Store and Apple Music are hit too.

Apple hasn't given a cause. Reports for Apple Pay and Apple Card have since dropped sharply, but other services are still affected.

📌 London, IRNA – Russian envoy to Vienna-based international organizations slammed the US and Israeli aggression against Iran’s safeguarded nuclear facilities as illegal, calling for collective diplomatic efforts to ease tensions and ensure security and stability in the Middle East.

Addressing the 7th Session of the UN ‘Conference on the Establishment of a Middle East Zone Free of Nuclear Weapons and Other Weapons of Mass Destruction’, Mikhail Ulyanov stressed that following the illegal US-Israeli aggression against Iran’s IAEA-safeguarded nuclear facilities in June 2025, they once again triggered an unprecedented escalation of tensions between February and April of this year.
​
Ulyanov also criticized the Israeli regime’s refusal to participate in the UN conference on establishing a WMD-free zone in the Middle East, describing it as the main obstacle to the progress of this forum’s activities.
​
The diplomat further referred to Russia’s proposal to establish a collective security system in the Persian Gulf region, saying the plan urges measures to turn the entire Middle East and North Africa into a zone free of weapons of mass destruction.
​
Ulyanov called on interested countries to review the proposal, adding that Russia is ready to cooperate and engage in dialogue on the existing proposals.
